_comment: Terraform directories deliberately NOT linted or planned by any workflow.
Read and enforced by .github/scripts/check_terraform_ci_coverage.py: an entry here
must name a directory that exists AND is not covered by any workflow, so an
exclusion cannot outlive its reason. Anything not listed here must be covered.
Adding an entry is a decision to leave code unlinted -- say why, not that it is.

excluded.reason: Runs against the organization MANAGEMENT account, and the OIDC_ROLE_ARN secret CI holds targets the workload account. Pointing CI at a role with management-account Organizations write access is a separate decision, taken explicitly rather than inherited. See environments/org-delegation/README.md, 'Where it runs'. Consequence, stated here because it is easy to miss: this directory gets no tflint, no fmt-check and no validate from CI, so run them by hand before changing it.

Consumed only by environments/org-delegation, which is excluded above for its credential boundary. A workflow filtering on this module would have nothing it could trigger a plan of. If this module ever gains a second consumer that IS in CI, delete this entry -- the coverage check will then require it.
